25660-games-for-the-playground-home-scho.title: And Gymnasium
25660-games-for-the-playground-home-scho.creator: Unknown
25660-games-for-the-playground-home-scho.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. But the object of the book has been by no means to present only novel material. There is an aristocracy of games, classic by all the rights of tradition and popular approval, without which a collection would be as incomplete as would an anthology of English ballads without _Robin Hood_, _Sally in our Alley_, or _Drink to me only with thine Eyes_.

arxiv-1904-07802.title: Learning 3D Navigation Protocols on Touch Interfaces with Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-1904-07802.creator: Quentin Debard, Jilles Steeve Dibangoye, Stéphane Canu, Christian Wolf
arxiv-1904-07802.description: Abstract Using touch devices to navigate in virtual 3D environments such as computer assisted design (CAD) models or geographical information systems (GIS) is inherently difficult for humans, as the 3D operations have to be performed by the user on a 2D touch surface.

arxiv-2008-03943.title: A robust and non-parametric model for prediction of dengue incidence
arxiv-2008-03943.creator: Atlanta Chakraborty, Vijay Chandru
arxiv-2008-03943.description: Abstract Disease surveillance is essential not only for the prior detection of outbreaks but also for monitoring trends of the disease in the long run. In this paper, we aim to build a tactical model for the surveillance of dengue, in particular.

arxiv-2111-05717.title: New results on the modification of jet structure in Heavy Ion collisions
arxiv-2111-05717.creator: on behalf of the ALICE, ATLAS, CMS collaborations
arxiv-2111-05717.description: Abstract These proceedings report recent studies performed by the ALICE, ATLAS and CMS experiments on jet substructure in p ​ p pp and Pb+Pb collisions at s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} = 5.02 TeV. The dependence of the modification of the jet shape on the dijet transverse momentum asymmetry is presented.

arxiv-2305-05802.title: Opportunistic Mutual Exclusion
arxiv-2305-05802.creator: Karthi Srinivasan, Yoram Moses, Rajit Manohar
arxiv-2305-05802.description: Abstract Mutual exclusion is an important problem in the context of shared resource usage, where only one process can be using the shared resource at any given time. A mutual exclusion protocol that does not use information on the duration for which each process uses the resource can lead to sub-optimal utilization times.

arxiv-2503-19924.title: Human brain state classification via permutation entropy of EEG phase dynamics across consciousness levels and inattentive-type ADHD
arxiv-2503-19924.creator: Athokpam Langlen Chanu, Youngjai Park, Jaesung Choi, Younghwa Cha, UnCheol Lee, Joon-Young Moon, Jong-Min Park
arxiv-2503-19924.description: Abstract We analyze electroencephalography (EEG) signals using the ordinal pattern framework to investigate whether different human brain states can be distinguished based on the disorder of EEG dynamics. Rather than analyzing raw EEG signals, we focus on the principal mode of EEG phase dynamics, reflecting anterior–posterior information flow, and quantify disorder using permutation entropy.

arxiv-2602-22050.title: Survival of Protoplanetary Disks in Upper Scorpius from Population Synthesis Models with External Photoevaporation
arxiv-2602-22050.creator: Jingyi Ping, Rossella Anania, Paola Pinilla, Miguel Vioque
arxiv-2602-22050.description: Abstract We present population synthesis models of viscous protoplanetary disks subject to mild external far-ultraviolet (FUV) radiation fields ( F UV = 1 F_{\mathrm{UV}}=1 –100 G 0 ). Our simulations focus on gas disk evolution, exploring stellar masses drawn from an Initial Mass Function and a range of initial disk conditions.

arxiv-2608-00175.title: Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2608-00175.creator: Umer Siddique, Peilang Li, Conor Wallace, Yongcan Cao

pmc-10500897.title: Vitamin D status in hospitalized COVID‑19 patients is associated with disease severity and IL-5 production
pmc-10500897.creator: Yali Qiu, Wuping Bao, Xue Tian, Yingying Zhang, Yilin Pan, Guogang Xie, Aihua Bao, Dongning Yin, Min Zhang, Yan Zhou
pmc-10500897.description: BackgroundThere are many studies on the relationship between vitamin D and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), while the results are matters of debate and the mechanisms remain unknown. The present study was performed to assess the impact of serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] levels on the severity of disease in hospitalized COVID-19 patients and identify potential mechanisms of 25(OH)D alterations.

pmc-10610750.title: Polycystic ovary syndrome and abdominal fat: is there a relationship?
pmc-10610750.creator: Carolina Furtado Macruz, Sônia Maria Rolim Rosa Lima
pmc-10610750.description: SUMMARYOBJECTIVE:The aim of this study was to compare the distribution of fat tissue in non-obese women with polycystic ovary syndrome and those without the syndrome using dual-energy radiological densitometry.METHODS:This was a case-control study in which we enrolled women aged 14–39 years with polycystic ovary syndrome according to the Rotterdam criteria with a body mass index between 18.5 and 30 kg/m2.

pmc-11387954.title: Development of a gold nanoparticle-based novel diagnostic prototype for in vivo detection of Indian red scorpion (Mesobuthus tamulus) venom
pmc-11387954.creator: Upasana Puzari, Mojibur R Khan, Ashis K Mukherjee
pmc-11387954.description: Indian red scorpion Mesobuthus tamulus is responsible for substantial mortality in India and Sri Lanka; however, no specific diagnostic method is available to detect the venom of this scorpion in envenomed plasma or body fluid. Therefore, we have proposed a novel, simple, and rapid method for detecting M.

pmc-11583826.title: Integrating Heat-Stable Carbetocin and Tranexamic Acid for Prevention and Management of Postpartum Hemorrhage in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Five-Country Pilot Implementation Study
pmc-11583826.creator: Sara Rushwan, Fatu Forna, Ferid Abbas Abubeker, Tesfaye Tufa, Tieba Millogo, Miriam Nakalembe, Kwame Adu-Bonsaffoh, Francis L. Moses, Lester Chinery, Gilda Piaggio, Metin Gülmezoglu
pmc-11583826.description: Background and ObjectiveGlobally, postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) remains the most common direct cause of maternal mortality. This study evaluated the feasibility and acceptability of introducing heat-stable carbetocin (HSC) for PPH prevention and tranexamic acid (TXA) for PPH treatment in five Sub-Saharan African countries following recent World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations.

pmc-11691060.title: FINDING FULFILLMENT IN NEW BEGINNINGS: EXPLORING LIFE SATISFACTION AMONG RESETTLED BHUTANESE OLDER ADULTS IN OHIO
pmc-11691060.creator: Isha Karmacharya, Saruna Ghimire
pmc-11691060.description: BackgroundThe decision for refugees to flee their home country is often driven by persecution, conflict, or other dire circumstances, leading to a significant disruption in their lives. The US, along with the state of Ohio, has provided a safety net for a significant number of Bhutanese refugees.

pmc-12359846.title: TOPK promotes immune suppression in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma and emerges as a prognostic and therapeutic target
pmc-12359846.creator: Zeyuan Zheng, Renhui Xiong, Xiuyuan Sui, Liyan Li, Huimin Sun, Chen Shao
pmc-12359846.description: The T-LAK cell-originated protein kinase (TOPK) has been associated with poor prognosis in various cancers, yet its specific role in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) remains unclear. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive investigation of TOPK expression and its association with immune infiltration in KIRC by integrating bioinformatics, in vitro, and in vivo approaches.

pmc-12550191.title: Impact of tea green leafhopper (Empoasca onukii) puncturing on the aroma profile of high-aroma oolong tea cultivars Jinguanyin and Jinmudan
pmc-12550191.creator: Baoyu Kong, Qiufang Zhu, Hang Wei, Qifu Liang, Mengzhu Shi, Ling Fang, Sun-an Yan, Jianwei Fu, Wenquan Yu
pmc-12550191.description: High-aroma Camellia sinensis cultivars Jinguanyin and Jinmudan are usually used to make black tea and lightly fermented oolong tea. The Oolong tea produced has a rich, lingering aroma and high quality. However, tea green leafhoppers can significantly reduce both yield and quality.

pmc-13128913.title: A Subphase-Labeled Mitotic Dataset for AI-powered Cell Division Analysis
pmc-13128913.creator: Zsanett Zsofia Ivan, Dominik Hirling, Istvan Grexa, Jonas Ammeling, Csaba Molnar, Tamas Micsik, Katalin Dobra, Levente Kuthi, Farkas Sukosd, Janos Fillinger, Judit Moldvay, Erika Toth, Marc Aubreville, Vivien Miczan, Peter Horvath
pmc-13128913.description: Mitosis detection represents a critical task in digital pathology, as it plays an important role in the tumor grading and prognosis of patients. Manual determination is a labor-intensive task for practitioners with high interobserver variability, thus, automation is a priority. There has been substantial progress towards creating robust mitosis detection algorithms, primarily driven by the Mitosis Domain Generalization (MIDOG) challenges.

pmc-13157357.title: A Diagnostic Odyssey: From Pulmonic to Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis
pmc-13157357.creator: Mustafa Arain, Taysir Al Janabi, Taha Abdul Rehman, Umair Tariq
pmc-13157357.description: Infective endocarditis (IE) carries substantial morbidity and mortality despite appropriate antibiotic therapy and surgery. Right-sided IE is uncommon, and isolated pulmonic valve involvement is particularly rare. Echocardiography, transthoracic (TTE) and especially transesophageal (TEE), remains the cornerstone of diagnosis, although sensitivity may be limited, particularly in prosthetic valves.

pmc-13175182.title: Endométriose pulmonaire chez une femme de 25 ans
pmc-13175182.creator: Qingping Zhong, Binglin Lai
pmc-13175182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). aient parfois accompagnés d’oppression et de douleur thoraciques. Quatorze mois plus tôt, elle avait donné naissance par césarienne. À l’examen, elle était afébrile. Sa numération leucocytaire était normale. Une tomodensitométrie (TDM) du thorax a révélé une opacité en verre dépoli isolée et hétérogène avec marges floues contenant des bronchogrammes aériens au niveau du lobe supérieur gauche, sans cavités ni nodules (figure 1, et annexe 1, figure 1A, accessible en anglais au www.cmaj.ca/lookup/doi/10.1503/cmaj.250997/tab-related-content).

pmc-13300562.title: Extracardiac vagal stimulation in cardioneuroablation procedures - comparison of two devices
pmc-13300562.creator: D Wichterle, H Jansova, P Stiavnicky, P Stojadinovic, P Peichl, R Cihak, J Kautzner
pmc-13300562.description: BackgroundExtracardiac vagal stimulation (ECVS) is a valuable tool for guiding cardioneuroablation (CNA). ECVS requires a high-frequency, high-output stimulation protocol. It appeared that neurostimulation cannot be accurately reproduced with conventional electrophysiology laboratory stimulators.PurposeTo compare the efficacy of ECVS using two devices with different stimulation protocols.MethodsThe study was conducted in 40 patients (age 40 ± 11 years, 50% male) undergoing cardioneuroablation.
